narrative.rotation_signal: Institutions are rotating INTO broad mega-cap tech (MSFT, AMZN, META, AAPL, GOOG/GOOGL), select semis (CSCO, KLAC, INTC, TXN), and defensives (COST, MA, WFC) — and OUT of the AI-momentum leaders (NVDA, PLTR, ORCL, MU, AMAT) plus money-center banks (BAC, GS). This looks like a de-risking within tech: rotating from crowded AI beneficiaries into the mega-cap platform names.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: NVDA, ORCL, PLTR, MU, AMAT bearish here would diverge from any broad 'AI/semis bullish' industry read — Top 50 shows the AI trade is being distributed at the single-name level even as breadth stays constructive. BAC/GS bearish also diverges from any bullish financials industry tape.
